name: json2dir-commonlisp
description: Common Lisp on SBCL with sb-posix, saved as an executable core
build: mkdir -p {src}/out && cd {src} && SBCL_HOME={runtimes}/sbcl-2.5.8/lib/sbcl {runtimes}/sbcl-2.5.8/bin/sbcl --noinform --non-interactive --no-sysinit --no-userinit --eval '(with-compilation-unit () (load "json2dir.lisp"))' --eval '(sb-ext:save-lisp-and-die "out/json2dir" :executable t :toplevel (function json2dir:main) :save-runtime-options t)'
